hipparcosVersionMismatch.note: Mismatch is a provenance check, not a significance test; HYG includes Gliese/manual exceptions. Its HIP astrometry predominantly uses the 2007 reduction; the current uncertainty table is I/239 (1997).

nearbyRedshiftOnly.note: d<10 million ly is a review heuristic, not an automatic rejection or an individual error estimate.

limitations: Hough candidates are alerts, not proofs of artifacts or physical structures.
No unknown depths are synthesized and no coordinates are changed.
GC association parsing uses the ATNF string; membership confidence and host radii need a scientific follow-up.
The 100 ly cluster radial spread threshold is only a triage threshold, not a universal cluster diameter.
Complete 3D relative geometry is not preserved by the radial map or its interpolated angular corrections.
